historicalReferencePolicy.publicationAuditDocuments: All file/hash observations in older publication-safety-audit*.json are dated audit observations, not currentsource contracts. Every nonmatch remains listed with pointer/expected/current hash. They do not exempt the actual currentadjacent/source/index checks.
historicalReferencePolicy.legacySlash: Only the exact superseded record and exact8 slashframe targets are historical; currentregistered manifest andadjacent files must still match or block.
historicalReferencePolicy.legacyExternalOriginals: Only6 exact record/target pairs explicitly classified from phase2; never read or restored. Any unknown externalhash reference requires root review.
historicalReferencePolicy.localRawGPU: work references are explicitly excluded and reported as local unpublished QA, not fetched or claimed public.

sourceLimitations: Hash identity does not prove image model/quality, art approval, animation smoothness or gameclient integration.
Historical source/recovered response gaps and nativealpha/registration/safeframe/phase/gutter WARNs remain disclosed.
Secret pattern scan cannot prove absence of every unknown secret; candidate values are never retained.
MP4 is hashed and checked through adjacent/source chains, never treated as PNG.
All Unity archive filemembers are hashed, PNGs decoded, text/JSON scanned, PNG/sourceindex coverage and embeddedrecord SHA checked without extracting tofilesystem.
Thirdparty references retain their existing attribution and rights; publication does not add a license.
